name: Luma
intro: Luma keeps dreaming of a ladder made of moonlight. Every step breaks before the top.
clue_1: The nightmare smells like warm milk and old paper.
clue_2: Luma says the moon never answers letters.
clue_3: A tiny envelope is tucked under one paw.
dream_gift: A moonlit mailbox that rings once, even when the answer is still far away.
morning_anchor: Tomorrow, Luma will write the first real letter instead of waiting for the perfect one.

name: Mori
intro: Mori's dream forest loops forever. A friend keeps waving from the path he did not take.
clue_1: The same leaf falls every twelve seconds.
clue_3: A seed glows whenever the dream turns backward.
dream_gift: A clearing where the missed goodbye can be spoken without the forest ending.
morning_anchor: Mori wakes with one seed to plant beside the old road.

name: Nini
intro: Nini is transparent tonight. A dark little storm keeps tapping from inside her chest.
clue_1: The storm grows louder when the room is silent.
clue_2: Nini laughs whenever she is about to cry.
clue_3: Her shadow is trying to hide under the clipboard.
dream_gift: A corked rain bottle, small enough to hold and safe enough to open later.
morning_anchor: Nini learns she can name a feeling before it fills the whole room.

name: Puff
intro: Puff wants wings, but every dream flight ends with the city lights drifting away.
clue_1: The wind chime only rings when Puff looks down.
clue_3: Puff whispers that roofs are almost skies.
dream_gift: One safe flight over the rooftops, with every window glowing hello.
morning_anchor: Puff decides to climb to the roof tomorrow and watch the sunrise from there.

name: Fenn
intro: Fenn's lantern goes out whenever the dream asks him to step onto a stage.
clue_1: Tiny applause hides inside the lantern glass.
clue_2: Fenn knows the song but not the first note.
clue_3: The nightmare is brightest just before he begins.
dream_gift: A stage where the first note can tremble and still count.
morning_anchor: Fenn wakes ready to sing badly once, which is how songs begin.

name: No. 7
intro: No. 7 arrives with no name tag. The dream door behind them locks itself twice.
clue_1: The nightmare repeats your last sentence in a smaller voice.
clue_3: A blank collar waits beside the dream door.
dream_gift: A quiet room where the word monster turns back into the word scared.
morning_anchor: No. 7 leaves with a blank tag and permission to choose a name later.
